goal: Add JWT authentication with PostgreSQL and a Next.js login page
summary: Persist users with PostgreSQL, implement JWT login and refresh endpoints, then add the Next.js login page that consumes them.

tasks.title: Create user persistence model for authentication
tasks.description: Create the database schema and migrations required to persist users and refresh tokens for JWT authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Migration creates the users table with a unique email column
Migration creates the refresh_tokens table referencing users
Migration applies successfully on an empty database

tasks.title: Implement JWT login and token issuance endpoints
tasks.description: Implement the login endpoint that verifies credentials against the persisted users and issues access and refresh JWT tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials return HTTP 200 with an access token and a refresh token
Invalid credentials return HTTP 401 without issuing tokens
Issued access tokens verify with the configured signing key

tasks.title: Implement refresh token rotation endpoint
tasks.description: Implement the refresh endpoint that validates a refresh token, rotates it, and issues a new access token.
acceptance_criteria: A valid refresh token returns HTTP 200 with a new access token
A reused or expired refresh token returns HTTP 401
Rotated refresh tokens are invalidated after use

tasks.title: Add Next.js login page consuming the auth endpoints
tasks.description: Implement the Next.js login page with form validation that calls the login endpoint and stores the issued tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Login form renders with email and password fields
Submitting valid credentials navigates to the post-login page
Failed logins display the error returned by the API

tasks.title: Cover authentication flows with automated tests
tasks.description: Add integration tests for the login and refresh endpoints and verify the login page flow end to end.
acceptance_criteria: Login success, login failure, and refresh rotation are covered by tests
